name: Financial services
description: Industry vocabulary only. Not financial advice, and not a substitute for compliance review.

hasDefinedTerm.name: APR
hasDefinedTerm.description: The yearly cost of borrowing including interest and most fees, expressed as a percentage.

hasDefinedTerm.name: APY
hasDefinedTerm.description: The yearly return on savings including compounding. Distinct from a simple interest rate.

hasDefinedTerm.name: basis point
hasDefinedTerm.description: One hundredth of a percentage point. Fifty basis points is half a percent.

hasDefinedTerm.name: prime rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: The reference rate banks quote to their most creditworthy borrowers.

hasDefinedTerm.name: fixed rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: An interest rate that does not change over the life of a loan.

hasDefinedTerm.name: variable rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: An interest rate that moves with an underlying index.

hasDefinedTerm.name: underwriting
hasDefinedTerm.description: Assessing the risk of a loan or policy and deciding the terms on which to accept it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: credit score
hasDefinedTerm.description: A model output summarizing credit risk from a borrower's history.

hasDefinedTerm.name: LTV ratio
hasDefinedTerm.description: The loan amount divided by the value of the asset securing it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: DTI
hasDefinedTerm.description: Monthly debt payments divided by gross monthly income. A common lending threshold.

hasDefinedTerm.name: amortization
hasDefinedTerm.description: Paying down a balance through scheduled payments that cover both interest and principal.

hasDefinedTerm.name: principal
hasDefinedTerm.description: The amount borrowed, separate from the interest charged on it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: origination fee
hasDefinedTerm.description: A charge for processing a new loan, usually a percentage of the amount.

hasDefinedTerm.name: refinance
hasDefinedTerm.description: Replacing an existing loan with a new one, usually for a different rate or term.

hasDefinedTerm.name: collateral
hasDefinedTerm.description: An asset pledged against a loan, which the lender may claim on default.

hasDefinedTerm.name: secured loan
hasDefinedTerm.description: Borrowing backed by collateral. Generally cheaper than unsecured borrowing.

hasDefinedTerm.name: default
hasDefinedTerm.description: Failure to meet the agreed obligations of a debt.

hasDefinedTerm.name: delinquency
hasDefinedTerm.description: A payment past due but not yet in default.

hasDefinedTerm.name: escrow
hasDefinedTerm.description: Funds held by a third party until the conditions of an agreement are met.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AUM
hasDefinedTerm.description: Assets under management. The total market value of assets a firm manages for clients.

hasDefinedTerm.name: expense ratio
hasDefinedTerm.description: The annual percentage of assets a fund charges to cover its operating costs.

hasDefinedTerm.name: liquidity
hasDefinedTerm.description: How quickly an asset can be converted to cash without materially moving its price.

hasDefinedTerm.name: diversification
hasDefinedTerm.description: Spreading exposure across assets so no single outcome dominates the result.

hasDefinedTerm.name: asset allocation
hasDefinedTerm.description: How a portfolio is divided across asset classes.

hasDefinedTerm.name: volatility
hasDefinedTerm.description: How much a price fluctuates over time. A common proxy for risk.

hasDefinedTerm.name: yield
hasDefinedTerm.description: Income from an investment expressed as a percentage of its price.

hasDefinedTerm.name: capital gain
hasDefinedTerm.description: The profit realized when an asset sells above its purchase price.

hasDefinedTerm.name: cost basis
hasDefinedTerm.description: The original purchase value used to calculate gain or loss on sale.

hasDefinedTerm.name: fiduciary
hasDefinedTerm.description: A party legally obliged to act in another's interest ahead of its own.

hasDefinedTerm.name: suitability
hasDefinedTerm.description: A standard requiring a recommendation to fit a client's circumstances. A lower bar than fiduciary duty.

hasDefinedTerm.name: prospectus
hasDefinedTerm.description: The formal disclosure document describing an investment offering.

hasDefinedTerm.name: index fund
hasDefinedTerm.description: A fund tracking a market index rather than selecting holdings actively.

hasDefinedTerm.name: ETF
hasDefinedTerm.description: Exchange-traded fund. A pooled fund whose shares trade on an exchange throughout the day.

hasDefinedTerm.name: KYC
hasDefinedTerm.description: Know your customer. Regulated identity verification performed before opening an account.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AML
hasDefinedTerm.description: Anti-money laundering. Controls and reporting designed to detect illicit funds moving through a business.

hasDefinedTerm.name: compliance
hasDefinedTerm.description: The function ensuring a business meets its regulatory and legal obligations.

hasDefinedTerm.name: PCI DSS
hasDefinedTerm.description: The security standard governing how card data is stored, processed, and transmitted.

ctx.expansion: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

hasDefinedTerm.name: chargeback
hasDefinedTerm.description: A forced reversal of a card payment initiated by the cardholder's bank.

hasDefinedTerm.name: open banking
hasDefinedTerm.description: Regulated sharing of bank data with third parties through APIs, at the customer's direction.

hasDefinedTerm.name: embedded finance
hasDefinedTerm.description: Financial products delivered inside a non-financial company's product experience.

hasDefinedTerm.name: ACH
hasDefinedTerm.description: The US network for batched bank-to-bank transfers. Cheaper and slower than card rails.

hasDefinedTerm.name: wire transfer
hasDefinedTerm.description: A direct bank-to-bank transfer, typically same day and irreversible.

hasDefinedTerm.name: trade settlement
hasDefinedTerm.description: The point at which a transaction's funds actually move between parties.

hasDefinedTerm.name: reconciliation
hasDefinedTerm.description: Matching internal records against external statements to confirm they agree.

hasDefinedTerm.name: audit trail
hasDefinedTerm.description: A tamper-evident record of who did what and when.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Reg BI
hasDefinedTerm.description: A US rule requiring broker-dealers to act in a retail customer's best interest when recommending.

hasDefinedTerm.name: disclosure
hasDefinedTerm.description: Required published information about risks, fees, or conflicts.

hasDefinedTerm.name: financial promotion
hasDefinedTerm.description: A regulated communication inviting investment activity. Subject to approval rules in many jurisdictions.

hasDefinedTerm.name: EBITDA
hasDefinedTerm.description: Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation, and amortization. A rough proxy for operating cash generation.

ctx.expansion: Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation, and amortization

hasDefinedTerm.name: working capital
hasDefinedTerm.description: Current assets minus current liabilities. What funds day-to-day operations.

hasDefinedTerm.name: runway
hasDefinedTerm.description: How long a business can operate at its current burn rate before it needs more capital.

hasDefinedTerm.name: cash flow
hasDefinedTerm.description: Money actually moving in and out, as distinct from revenue booked.

hasDefinedTerm.name: accounts receivable
hasDefinedTerm.description: Money owed to a business by its customers.
